summary: Itau Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Pillar 3 Risk and Capital Management report for Q1 2026, as required under Basel III disclosure rules. No special situation transaction or corporate event is described; the filing contains only regulatory capital metrics, risk-weighted assets, liquidity ratios, and credit risk disclosures. There is no offer, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign issuer.
